'''Disturbed Ancestors''' are the spirits of the [[tauren]] of the [[Moonhoof tribe]] found at the [[Ancestral Grounds]] in [[Moonwhisper Coast]]. Their rest has been disturbed by the somber energies invoked by the [[Shadewalkers]] of [[An'she's Respite]].
